title: Roasted garlic tomatoes
description: Sweet, jammy tomatoes roasted with garlic and olive oil. Perfect on toast or with pasta.
steps: Cut the tomatoes in half and place them cut side up on a baking sheet.
Drizzle with olive oil, then sprinkle with the garlic, salt and pepper.
Roast for 20–25 minutes, until soft and slightly caramelised.
Scatter the torn basil leaves on top and serve warm.
notes: Leftovers keep 3 days in the fridge — blend them into a quick pasta sauce.
